description.narrative: Supports the local delivery of Chevening’s engagement activities across the applicant, scholar, and alumni journey in ODA eligible countries. This fund enables Chevening Officers to build and maintain strong networks, promote the programme and foster long-term impact through targeted outreach, events, and alumni initiatives tailored to local contexts.
